verdicts.quote: A file with one invalid record alongside valid records, or a write failure confirmed before the batch took effect, creates zero accounts attributable to that upload.
If several checks fail, the result identifies at least one blocking input error. Error ordering and the number of further errors are left open.
verdicts.missing: Whether the result lists every failing row and its reason or only the first; C-41/C-100 locate a reported error but completeness is left open.

verdicts.quote: When a submitted identity conflicts with an account reserved under the destination's ordinary uniqueness policy, the affected record gets a conflict error. / Two rows resolving to the same uniqueness key cause a file conflict.
CSV submission itself cannot grant elevated privileges. / In the default schema `name`, `role`, `password`, `id`, `tenant`, `status` and `permissions` are unsupported
A signed-out caller, a signed-in non-admin or an admin without create authority in that destination cannot open it.
verdicts.missing: Whether import needs a permission distinct from single-user create authority; the spec gates import on admin plus create authority, so the ability is effectively implied by create permission.

verdicts.quote: The first record after any ignored empty lines is read as column labels. / An empty header field or header with no `email` yields a header error. / A file with headers beyond the supported required fields yields an error
valid UTF-8 with no byte-order mark or with one UTF-8 byte-order mark / LF, CRLF or a mixture pass / A field enclosed in double quotes treats commas and LF or CRLF as part of the value.
Submitting a confirmed rejected or failed batch causes zero invitations or onboarding messages attributable to that batch.
A file of 1,048,577 bytes is refused with a file-size error. / A file with 1,001 user records yields a record-count error.
A zero-byte file or a valid header with zero user records creates zero users and yields an input error. / An otherwise valid file with exactly one new user record creates one user.
If the identities in the original file are still reserved, resubmitting it yields conflicts and creates zero accounts.
any requirement to continue work outside the request are unconfirmed / While the result is pending and the admin stays in the flow, the import shows that the submission is still being processed.
verdicts.missing: Whether a large file runs in the background and how the admin is told it finished if they leave the flow.

verdicts.quote: an imported user gets that same notification under the same conditions after the account exists... Notification channels, triggers and delivery rules are unconfirmed.
verdicts.missing: Whether up to 1,000 invitations are sent at once or paced, and at what rate.

verdicts.missing: Where the uploaded file is stored during processing and how long it is retained or when it is deleted.
